title: FAST VETS Act
official_title: To amend title 38, United States Code, to modify the conditions under which the Secretary of Veterans Affairs is required to redevelop the individualized vocational rehabilitation plan for a veteran, and for other purposes.
likelihoodReason: Enacted as Public Law 119-72 on January 20, 2026. Per the printed legislative history for H.R. 4446, the House considered and passed the measure on September 15, 2025 and the Senate considered and passed it on December 18, 2025.
summary: Modifies the redevelopment step of the Department of Veterans Affairs' individualized vocational rehabilitation plan process. Section 3107(b) of title 38, United States Code, is restructured so that after the required review, the Secretary either (A) redevelops the plan when the veteran's long-range rehabilitation goals are no longer feasible due to changes in the veteran's employment handicap and are likelier under a different plan formulated under subsection (a), or (B) disapproves redevelopment when the Secretary determines it is not appropriate.
brief: Amends 38 U.S.C. 3107(b) so that, after reviewing a veteran's vocational rehabilitation plan, the VA Secretary either redevelops it under specified conditions or disapproves redevelopment when not appropriate.

subs: The prior second sentence is struck

Disapprove redevelopment when the Secretary determines redevelopment is not appropriate

items.main: Names the Act the "Focused Assistance and Skills Training for Veterans' Employment and Transition Success Act" or the "FAST VETS Act."
items.detail: Short-title section — citation name only; no substantive effect.

sections.label: Section 2 — Conditions Under Which Secretary of Veterans Affairs Shall Redevelop Individualized Vocational Rehabilitation Plan

items.main: Amends subsection (b) of section 3107 of title 38, United States Code, by striking "The Secretary shall review" and inserting "(1) The Secretary shall review"; by striking the second sentence; and by adding a new paragraph (2).
items.detail: The rewrite converts the existing single-sentence review requirement into a numbered paragraph (1) and clears out the prior second sentence, making room for the new determination framework.

items.main: New paragraph (2) directs the Secretary, on the basis of the review, to (A) redevelop the plan when long-range rehabilitation goals are no longer feasible due to changes in the veteran's employment handicap and are likelier under a different plan formulated under subsection (a), or (B) disapprove redevelopment when it is determined not to be appropriate.
items.detail: Both criteria in prong (A) — infeasibility due to changes in the employment handicap and higher likelihood under a different plan — must be met before the Secretary redevelops the plan.

gaps: The bill does not describe how the Secretary must document a determination that redevelopment is not appropriate.
The bill does not set a deadline within which the Secretary must act on the review before the veteran's plan status is resolved.
The bill does not create appeal rights specific to the new redevelopment or disapproval determinations.
The bill does not authorize additional funding for the vocational rehabilitation program to support the restructured review.

added: New 38 U.S.C. 3107(b)(2): two-path Secretary determination — redevelop under specified conditions or disapprove redevelopment when not appropriate
modified: 38 U.S.C. 3107(b): existing review sentence renumbered as paragraph (1)
removed: The prior second sentence of 38 U.S.C. 3107(b)
